title: Pipo e as Quatro Cores
learning_goal: Reconhecer e nomear vermelho, amarelo, azul e verde.
takeaway: As cores estão em todo lugar, e a gente sabe o nome delas.

style_bible.art_style: flat 2D vector cartoon, soft rounded shapes, thick clean outlines, storybook look
style_bible.lighting: soft daylight, warm and cheerful, no harsh shadows

characters.name: Pipo
characters.description: Pipo, a small round puppy with cream fur, big floppy brown ears, one brown patch over the left eye, a red neckerchief, large friendly eyes, always smiling

music: gentle ukulele and soft xylophone, cheerful, about 95 bpm, loops smoothly
voice: voz feminina calorosa e alegre, português do Brasil, fala lenta e clara, pausa depois de cada pergunta

publishing.title: Aprenda as Cores com o Pipo 🐶 Vermelho, Amarelo, Azul e Verde
publishing.description: Passeie com o cachorrinho Pipo e aprenda quatro cores: vermelho, amarelo, azul e verde. Para crianças de 2 a 4 anos. Ilustrações e voz feitas com ajuda de inteligência artificial; história e personagens originais.
publishing.thumbnail_idea: Pipo holding a big red apple, smiling at the viewer, with yellow, blue and green circles floating behind him

scenes.setting: sunny meadow with three tall sunflowers
scenes.visual: Pipo stands in the middle of the meadow and waves at the camera
scenes.action: Pipo waves one paw and smiles
scenes.narration: Oi, amigo! Vamos ver as cores?
scenes.sound: soft happy jingle, then music under the voice

scenes.setting: sunny meadow with an apple tree
scenes.visual: Pipo points at a big shiny red apple hanging on a branch
scenes.action: Pipo points at the apple and tilts his head
scenes.narration: Olha a maçã! Vermelho! Fala comigo: vermelho!
scenes.sound: small pop when the apple appears; 2 seconds of silence after the question

scenes.setting: open meadow with a big bright sun in the sky
scenes.visual: Pipo looks up at a big yellow sun with a friendly face
scenes.action: Pipo shades his eyes with one paw and smiles
scenes.camera: gentle tilt up from Pipo to the sky

scenes.setting: calm blue sky with two fluffy white clouds
scenes.visual: Pipo lies on his back on the grass looking at the blue sky

scenes.setting: green grass field with small flowers
scenes.visual: Pipo sits on bright green grass and pats it with his paw
scenes.action: Pipo pats the grass and looks at the viewer
scenes.narration: A grama é verde. Verde! Muito bem!

scenes.setting: cream background with four large colored circles in a row
scenes.visual: Four big circles in red, yellow, blue and green appear one after another, Pipo stands beside them
scenes.action: Pipo points to each circle in turn
scenes.sound: one soft note for each circle

scenes.setting: sunny meadow with three tall sunflowers
scenes.visual: Pipo jumps happily with a small rainbow of confetti in the air
scenes.sound: happy cheer, music resolves and fades
